'''Governor of Naboo''' was a permanent, democratically-elected [[Politics/Legends|political]] office respective to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Naboo [[Governor/Legends|governor]] led the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]].

[[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] served as Governor of Naboo during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
